verdict.rationale: Render documents custom domains with free TLS (including wildcards) and a general REST API/CLI that could be used to automate domain setup, but there is no evidence of a dedicated multi-tenant/SaaS custom-domain provisioning workflow (e.g., per-tenant domain API endpoints, verification flow, or routing rules for customer-owned domains). missing for 10: explicit API/documentation for programmatically adding customer-owned domains per tenant, domain verification workflow, and any SaaS-specific routing guidance.
